selected.resumen:

Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale.

selected.titulo: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
selected.resumen:
Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.

It's rolling out now globally on all ChatGPT plans on the web, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps.
